correctness.rationale: Independent replay confirms the refutation core. Standard representation rho(s1)=[[1,1],[0,1]], rho(s2)=[[1,0],[-1,1]] satisfies braid relation (both products = [[0,1],[-1,0]]) with det 1. For w*=s1^3 s2^-1 s1 s2^-2: s1^3=[[1,3],[0,1]], s2^-2=[[1,0],[2,1]]; left-to-right product = [[18,7],[5,2]], right-to-left = transpose [[2,7],[5,18]]; both trace 20, det 1. Hence |tr|=20>2 so pseudo-Anosov under standard B3->SL(2,Z) trace classification (|tr|>2 pA, =2 reducible, <2 periodic; center maps to +/-I with |tr|=2 so does not affect pA determination; trace invariant under transpose/inverse/cyclic permutation so convention-independent). Charpoly x^2-20x+1, discriminant 396=20^2-4, 361<396<400 so non-square, irreducible degree 2 not 6. Roots 10+/-3*sqrt(11). Integer bounds 3316^2=10995856 < 11000000 < 3317^2=11002489 give 3.316<sqrt(11)<3.317, hence lambda=10+3*sqrt(11) in (19.948,19.951), conjugate in (0.049,0.052); product 1, both real positive reciprocal, no unit-circle conjugate, so quadratic Pisot not Salem (Salem needs degree>=4 with all-but-two conjugates on unit circle). f(1.401)=-25057199/1000000 !=0; gaps >17 (large root) and >1.3 (small root). Calibration rho(s1*s2^-1)=[[2,1],[1,1]] trace 3 -> (3+sqrt(5))/2~2.618 confirms conventions. General bound: integer |tr|>=3 for pA 3-braid gives lambda>=(3+sqrt(5))/2>2.618>1.401, quadratic. All steps exact integer arithmetic; decimals display-only. Script 23/23 PASS replayed. Proof distinguished from experiment. Scope honestly limited: face/polynomial/tolerance absent so clause (d) unaudited; no M_s/marking so higher-genus re-reading untestable. Core (a) TRUE, (b)-(c) FALSE, conjunction FALSE — correctly proved.
